'''''[[Thannik's Thunder]]''''' was a [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[720 light freighter/Legends|720 light freighter]] operated by a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] named [[Rhen]]. She flew the freighter in combat against [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] flying [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], and against Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]].<ref name="TRG" />

==Behind the scenes==
No connection between ''Thannik's Thunder'' and Rhen's associate, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Thannik]], is explicitly stated in ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'', the only source for this ship.<ref name="TRG" />
